description: This file is a PHP script for a web application, specifically part of the TestLink project. It handles the logic for adding test cases to a test plan via a navigator interface, building a dynamic tree menu, initializing GUI elements, and rendering the page with a Smarty template.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP standard class used here as a container for GUI parameters.

classes.name: tlTestCaseFilterByRequirementControl
classes.description: A control class for filtering test cases by requirement in the test plan process.

classes.name: tlTestCaseFilterControl
classes.description: A general control class for managing test case filtering options.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper class used for rendering HTML views.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes and configures the GUI object used in templates, including URLs, activity strings, and session/session control handling.
